description: We are a team of six students and technology enthusiasts with skills in AI/ML, software engineering, data science, research, UI/UX, and product development. For NASA Space Apps 2026’s “Be an Earth System Trend Detective!” challenge, we aim to explore NASA Earth data, identify meaningful Earth-system trends, and build an accessible AI-driven solution.
summary:
NEIA is an AI-powered scientific research agent that converts natural language questions into reproducible NASA Earth observation analysis. 
Instead of relying on LLM hallucination, NEIA orchestrates a deterministic scientific pipeline - retrieving real satellite data (SMAP, MODIS, Landsat), calculating environmental trends, and delivering evidence-backed answers. The system allows non-technical users to ask questions in plain language and receive transparent, actionable insights regarding drought risk, soil salinity, and crop vulnerability. 
Every numerical result is computed through a deterministic scientific engine, while the LLM serves only to explain the result, ensuring scientific validity and full transparency.
details:
We built NEIA (NASA Earth Intelligence Agent), an AI-powered research agent designed for the "Be An Earth System Trend Detective!" challenge. It bridges the gap between complex satellite data and real-world climate action.

NEIA solves the AI "hallucination" problem through a unique Glass Box architecture: the LLM acts solely as a translator, while a deterministic Python engine performs the math on real NASA datasets (MODIS, GPM, SMAP, Landsat, GRACE).

When users ask plain-language questions (e.g., "What is the flood risk in Sylhet?"), NEIA extracts the parameters, retrieves decades of NASA data, and runs advanced statistical tests (Mann-Kendall, Z-score). It uncovers hidden Earth system trends and moves beyond prediction to prescription—like recommending salt-tolerant crops based on real-time soil salinity calculations.

Every answer includes a transparent Evidence Dossier with formulas, data completeness, and reproducible code. This ensures 100% scientific validity, empowering vulnerable communities to build climate resilience.
